claim: Mistral AI CEO Arthur Mensch joined the first session on competitiveness and AI sovereignty.

support.quote: Joined by Arthur Mensch, CEO of Mistral AI, the leaders discussed Europe's position in the global AI landscape and the strategic choices needed to strengthen Europe's competitiveness and AI sovereignty.

support.quote: Europe has all the technology and the talent to lead the AI race
